data.name: Saraswati
data.gender_notes: Saraswati is used as a female name in hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Sanskrit saras, 'pool, flowing water', + vatī, 'possessing' — 'she who possesses water/flow'. Its root is Sanskrit saras + vatī. Saraswati, goddess of knowledge, music and the arts. Saraswati is a Sanskrit name meaning “Flowing; possessing water; eloquent”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses.
data.spiritual_meaning: Saraswati expresses “Flowing; possessing water; eloquent”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.etymology: From the Sanskrit saras, 'pool, flowing water', + vatī, 'possessing' — 'she who possesses water/flow'.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Saraswati total 30, reducing to 3. Number 3 is associated with expression, creativity and optimism.

vedic_reference.note: Saraswati is one of the major deities in Hinduism and is the goddess of knowledge, music, arts, wisdom, and learning. She is often depicted holding a veena (a musical instrument), a book, and a lotus flower.
